searchText: Hey, guys. I have a question about discv5. Is there any testnet clients that I can try discovery? Or is there any test vectors for ENR record that I can use for development? Thanks in advance! https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/discv5/discv5-wire-test-vectors.md Thanks! <@905058765022310460> BTW, is there anything like testnet for development purpose? I mean the real clients which I can discover, gossip the block data, etc, for just development purpose. You can just try to start another client locally and try to connect. Or I think you can also just use Sepolia or Goerli for that. There is no harm in connecting to another client.
